policies.label: Quality First
policies.description: Maximize outcome quality while retaining small health, privacy, latency and cost signals.

policies.label: Cost Aware
policies.description: Reduce spend while preserving provider quality and health.

policies.label: Private / Local
policies.description: Forbid remote transfer and keep execution on local or first-party providers.

policies.label: Balanced
policies.description: Balance quality, privacy, speed, cost, and health.

policies.label: Regulated / Governed
policies.description: Strongly favor healthy, privacy-compatible providers and reject degraded state.
